en.name: Atheist
en.ability: The Storyteller can break the game rules & if executed, good wins, even if you are dead. [No evil characters]
en.flavor: Let us disperse with unnecessary conjecture and silly paranoia. There is a perfectly rational explanation for everything. Yes, a teacup may indeed be orbiting the planet, too small to see, but I shall drink my tea from the very real china in my very real hands.
